children: Apple (AAPL) topped $5 trillion market cap on Oct 14, 2026; John Ternus named CEO, HomeView smart speaker unveiled Oct 13, and iPhone 18 Pro plus iPhone Duo showcased.
Apple (AAPL) will roll out AI platform and features in mainland China in December with iOS 27.3. Launch follows regulatory delay; specific localized features for China not yet disclosed.
iPhone demand drives Apple (AAPL): recent data show a pickup in unit shipments, led by higher-end iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, despite higher prices and fewer carrier discounts.
Apple (AAPL) launched HomeView, a $299 seven-inch smart display with Siri AI for up to six profiles (requires iPhone/iPad), preorders open, ships Nov. 13; not initially sold in EU.
Apple raised supply orders for its upcoming foldable iPhone Duo by 30%, lifting initial units to about 10 million ahead of preorders set for October 16.
Apple asked suppliers to cut component output for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max amid weakening demand as prices rise; adjustments target high-end model parts, per Nikkei Asia.
AAPL rose ~1.4% to $346.16 intraday after HomeView news, briefly hitting a record near $348.15. Key resistance: $348–350. Support zones: $340–341 and $336–338.
China approved permits on Sept 29 letting recent iPhone models in China run Apple Intelligence and local AI models (including Alibaba’s Qwen and Tongyi Wanxiang), per the report.
Apple (AAPL) launched a refreshed Apple TV 4K ($299) and HomePod mini 2 ($149) shipping Nov 13, plus a Home Collection with cameras, thermostats and a smart lock; some camera features need iCloud+.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) saw notable ETF inflows in the latest GuruFocus ETF flow data, ranking among the largest U.S. stocks receiving ETF buying alongside other big-cap names.
